And it will really knock you out (Part 2)
There are twist endings… and then there’s The Others (2001).
Set in a fog-drenched mansion, it follows Grace and her two children who live in constant darkness , because sunlight harms the kids. But as strange events unfold, the line between the living and the dead blurs in ways you won’t see coming.

Nicole Kidman delivers one of her most haunting performances ever fragile yet commanding and that final revelation? It’s a masterclass in psychological storytelling. 
It is one of those horror films that will stay with you forever.

What is your favourite horror films that you often rewatch?!

Where do you rate THE OTHERS on the scale of 1 to 10 ?
